name: Buna
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Buna was a son of Jerahmeel, who was a descendant of Judah through Perez and Hezron. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of the tribe of Judah's lineage. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Buna is listed as one of the sons of Jerahmeel in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Jerahmeel was Hezron's firstborn son, and his descendants, including Buna, were recorded as part of the history of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Hezron
keyEvents.description: Hezron was the son of Perez and the grandson of Judah, placing Buna in an important lineage in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: The books of Chronicles provide a detailed overview of Judah's descendants, with Buna included as part of the broader family history of God's chosen people.
